messages:
Nora: Quick kickoff 1  Weve got an ISV tooling partner asking for a certified LangChain/LlamaIndex adapter + a joint marketplace listing. Goal: a turn-key 'retrieval + rerank + summarize' flow that customers can deploy on the NVIDIA bundle. Owners and rough ETA?
Evan: Eng can pick up a minimal adapter (ingest -> query -> stream responses) in ~10 working days if QA helps. need a clear contract for caching and batching.
Priya: DevRel will prepare a short tutorial + sample KB. prefer a reproducible Jupyter notebook + CLI sample. Ill own the notebook.
InfraBot: Perf note: benchmark window on A10x2 next Tue. baseline job needs 500 synthetic queries across varying seq lengths. ETA 3 business days for results.
Nora: Marketplace/legal bits: publisher agreement + security attestation are required. Ill start intake today. also need: 512x512 icon, short description, support contact, and pricing SKU mapping.
DesignBot: I can make a 30s demo GIF and two screenshots once notebook link is live. send high-res logos.
Evan: example demo invocation for the README:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/adapters/lc-lindex/run \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD' \n  -d '{"flow":"kb-rerank-sum","source":"lindex://kb-demo","max_tokens":140,"stream":true}'
```
Evan: adapter config i'll push to repo: `name: rwd-lc-lindex`, `batch:8`, `stream:true`, `quant:q4_0`
Priya: timeline proposal: PR in 8 working days, QA + smoke 4 days, perf 3 days, assets + manifest 4 days, legal 5 days. external listing target = 4 weeks. internal demo + press ready = 3 weeks.
Nora: Owners: Adapter = @Evan, Notebook & demo = @Priya, Perf/infra = @InfraBot (cc @Evan), Assets/marketing = @DesignBot, Marketplace legal = @Nora.
Priya: I'll scaffold notebook today and include a tiny KB (privacy-safe). will add runnable cells for local and marketplace flows.
Evan: tagging infra and qa on PR. will include smoke tests: basic query, rerank correctness, streaming.
Nora: I'll open the marketplace intake and link the publisher checklist: https://rwd.internal/partners/marketplace-checklist
DesignBot: :eyes: will queue assets once notebook posted.
InfraBot: perf job scheduled (JOB-8891). expect results by Fri.
Nora: Let's run 15-min sync every Wed until launch. please react :white_check_mark: when your item is green.
Evan: :white_check_mark: adapter scaffolded, PR draft this afternoon.
Priya: :white_check_mark: notebook scaffold up.
Nora: :eyes: legal intake started (TKT-5512).
DesignBot: :soon: assets queued.
Nora: Thanks team 1. I'll consolidate timeline into a one-page playbook after perf lands.
